items.title: Where the U.S. and China Stand on AI Safety
items.summary: The two countries will meet this month for an official AI safety bilateral, Reuters reported The U.S. and China will discuss artificial intelligence safety in mid-September, Reuters reported , following up on a May agreement to “start talking” about best practices and guardrails for AI.

items.title: Robots Marched On Poland's Digital Ministry To Demand AI Regulation
items.summary: About 30 humanoid and quadruped robots demonstrated outside Poland's Ministry of Digital Affairs in Warsaw on September 7, demanding regulation of the AI and robotics that could replace human workers.

items.title: Anthropic has broken with OpenAI and Google over the toughest AI safety bill in America
items.summary: A Massachusetts proposal would require large AI developers to hire independent evaluators to assess catastrophic risk in their models every four months — a cadence stricter than anything else at state level in the United States.
